Mini Skid Steers — common questions

What is a mini skid steer loader used for?

Mini skid steers are used for moving and loading materials, grading, snow removal, demolition cleanup, landscaping, and running powered attachments like augers, trenchers, breakers and brooms.

Mini skid steer vs compact track loader — what's the difference?

Mini skid steers run on wheels and are fast and lower-cost. Compact track loaders run on rubber tracks for better traction and float on soft, wet or sloped ground. Konstructz offers both formats so you can match the surface to the task.

Can I run any attachment on a mini skid steer?

Many attachments mount through quick-attach couplers, but the key checks are coupler type, hydraulic flow and machine lift class. Tools such as cold planers, mulchers and rock saws need a matching hydraulic setup.

How heavy a load can a mini skid steer lift?

The STOMP V980 and V950 have operating capacities of 2,090 lbs and 2,160 lbs respectively. Always confirm that the combined weight of your attachment and material load remains within safe operating limits.
